name: Panicled Bulrush
desc: Panicled Bulrush (Scirpus microcarpus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Scirpus microcarpus is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family known by the common names panicled bulrush, smallfruit bulrush, and barberpole bulrush.
